title: Generalized Cartan matrices and realizations
source: Kac, Infinite-Dimensional Lie Algebras, 3rd ed. corrected reprint, §§1.0–1.1, archived PDF pp. 24–25 (conditions and realization), and §2.1, p. 39 (symmetrizability).

title: Existence and uniqueness of a minimal realization
source: Kac, Proposition 1.1, archived PDF p. 25.

title: The universal algebra before the quotient
source: Kac, Theorem 1.2(a)–(d), archived PDF pp. 26–28; the tensor-word action and graded spanning proof are supplied here.
proof_dependencies: KM01; KM02; Lie Algebras and Finite-Dimensional Representations A05 and A07, PDF pp. 8–9

title: The Cartan-disjoint ideal and the center
source: Kac, Theorem 1.2(e) and §§1.3, 1.6, archived PDF pp. 26, 28–30, 34.

title: Serre relations in the quotient
source: Kac, §3.3 and Lemma 3.5, archived PDF pp. 55–56. The quotient implication is proved here directly in both signs.

title: Reflection automorphisms and real roots
source: Kac, Proposition 3.7 and §3.9, archived PDF pp. 58, 60. Invariance on the possibly degenerate simple-root form is calculated here.

title: An infinite rank-two root orbit
source: Two-by-two calculation in this chapter using Kac §3.7, archived PDF p. 58 for the general reflection convention.

title: Highest-weight modules and integrability
source: Kac, §§9.2–9.3 and Lemma 10.1, archived PDF pp. 169–171, 194; Proposition 3.7, p. 58 for weight symmetry.
proof_dependencies: KM04; KM05; KM06; Lie Algebras and Finite-Dimensional Representations A05, PDF pp. 8–9; Topics in Representation Theory LO12, PDF p. 27, for the rank-one formula and affine comparison

title: The contragredient affine algebra is the loop model
source: Kac, §§7.1–7.4, Theorem 7.4, archived PDF pp. 119–124; Hernandez, An Introduction to Affine Kac–Moody Algebras, §§3–4, archived PDF pp. 4–10.
proof_dependencies: KM03; KM04; Lie Algebras and Finite-Dimensional Representations D04 and E09, PDF pp. 24–25, 34–35; Topics in Representation Theory LO09–LO10, PDF p. 26

title: The Witt algebra is simple and perfect
source: Kac, §7.3 and bracket (7.3.3), archived PDF pp. 121–122, for vector fields and their bracket. Simplicity and perfectness are proved directly here.
proof_dependencies: Polynomial extraction in an eigenspace decomposition, as used in KM04

title: The Virasoro cocycle and the universal extension
source: Kac, §7.3, bracket (7.3.3), archived PDF p. 122; the complete vector-valued cocycle classification and universal property are proved here.
proof_dependencies: KM10; normalization of alternating cocycles via a linear section, with proof here

title: Witt derivations lift to the affine central extension
source: Kac, §7.3, Proposition 7.3 and formulas (7.3.1)–(7.3.3), archived PDF pp. 121–122.
proof_dependencies: KM09; KM10; KM11; Topics in Representation Theory LO09, PDF p. 26

title: Virasoro Verma modules
source: Kac, §9.14, formulas (9.14.1)–(9.14.3), archived PDF pp. 186–187.
proof_dependencies: KM11; Lie Algebras and Finite-Dimensional Representations A05, PDF pp. 8–9

title: Singular vectors in degrees one and two
source: Kac, §9.14, archived PDF pp. 186–187 for the convention; low-degree equations and determinant calculated here.
proof_dependencies: KM11; KM13; Lie Algebras and Finite-Dimensional Representations A05, PDF pp. 8–9

title: Lie superalgebras and their modules
source: Musson, Lie Superalgebras and Enveloping Algebras, §1.1, archived PDF pp. 22–24. Serganova, Kac–Moody Superalgebras and Integrability, §2, archived PDF pp. 3–5. The characteristic-three convention is explicit here.

title: The supercommutator and the smallest matrix example
source: Musson, Lemma 1.1.2 and §2.2, archived PDF pp. 23 and 33–34. The rank-one bracket and supertrace calculations are given here.

title: Super Poincare–Birkhoff–Witt
source: Musson, Theorem 6.1.1, printed pp. 132–134, archived PDF pp. 153–155. All overlap reductions including repeated odd generators are proved here.

title: Simple graded modules for complex gl(1|1)
source: Musson, §2.2, archived PDF pp. 33–34 for the algebra. Serganova, §3, archived PDF pp. 6–8 for the odd-reflection context. The rank-one module classification and opposite-highest-line computation are supplied here.

title: Associative p-powers and the Jacobson polynomials
source: Jantzen, Representations of Lie Algebras in Positive Characteristic, §§A.1–A.2, archived PDF pp. 1–2. Strade–Farnsteiner, §2.1, printed p. 61 (DjVu p. 68). The noncommutative derivative proof is in this chapter.
proof_dependencies: Formal differentiation with a central variable and the binomial identity in characteristic p

title: Restricted Lie algebras
source: Jantzen, §§A.1–A.2, archived PDF pp. 1–2. Strade–Farnsteiner, §2.1, printed p. 61 (DjVu p. 68).

title: Matrix and derivation p-operations
source: Jantzen, §A.2, archived PDF p. 2. Strade–Farnsteiner, §4.2, printed p. 146 (DjVu p. 153), for the Jacobson–Witt setting.
proof_dependencies: SR05; SR06; Lie Algebras and Finite-Dimensional Representations J09, PDF p. 72 for the older simplicity example

title: Polynomial p-center and reduced PBW
source: Jantzen, §§A.3 and A.7, archived PDF pp. 2–3 and 4–5. Strade–Farnsteiner, §§2.5 and 5.3, printed pp. 90 and 212 (DjVu pp. 97 and 219).
proof_dependencies: SR05; SR06; Lie Algebras and Finite-Dimensional Representations A05, PDF pp. 8–9

title: The p-character of a finite-dimensional simple module
source: Jantzen, §A.7, archived PDF pp. 4–5.

title: Baby Verma induction
source: Jantzen, §§B.3–B.4, archived PDF pp. 6–7. The explicit rank-one basis actions are derived here.

title: The zero p-character
source: Jantzen, §B.4, archived PDF p. 7, for induction. The zero-character rank-one simple-quotient proof and dimension calculation are given here.

title: Nonzero semisimple and nilpotent p-characters
source: Jantzen, §B.10, archived PDF pp. 9–10, for regular semisimple characters, and §C.3, archived PDF pp. 11–12, for regular nilpotent characters. This chapter derives the rank-one classifications by their explicit weight actions.

title: The two-generator positive part
source: Etingof–Semenyakin, A Brief Introduction to Quantum Groups, Section 4.1, Theorem 4.1, archived PDF p. 23, for the quantum Serre presentation. The explicit two-generator Ore-basis proof is given here.
proof_dependencies: Topics in Rings, Modules, and Associative Algebras, O11, PDF p. 34

title: The generic and truncated formal presentations
source: Kassel, Quantum Groups, Section XVII.2, Definition XVII.2.3, archived PDF pp. 420–422; Etingof–Semenyakin Sections 4.1–4.2, archived PDF pp. 22–25. Formal series convention here uses q=exp(h).

title: Normal form before the Serre quotient
source: Direct rewriting argument proved here for the two free Serre halves. Compare the Drinfeld–Jimbo presentation in Kassel Section XVII.2, archived PDF pp. 420–423.

title: Crossing the Serre ideal
source: Direct mixed commutator verification for type A2 and its two coefficient models. For the general presentation see Etingof–Semenyakin Section 4.1, archived PDF pp. 22–24.

title: Triangular PBW in type A2
source: Kassel Section XVII.2, archived PDF pp. 422–423 for triangular structure; the explicit A2 PBW basis with the same family in all formal truncations is proved here.
proof_dependencies: UQ01; UQ02; UQ03; UQ04; Topics in Rings, Modules, and Associative Algebras H10, PDF p. 25

title: Coproduct and antipode in type A2
source: Kassel Section XVII.2, Definition XVII.2.3 and Theorem XVII.2.4, archived PDF p. 422; Etingof–Semenyakin Section 4.1, archived PDF pp. 22–24. The A2 mixed Serre check is given here.

title: A topologically free quantization of the enveloping algebra
source: Kassel Sections XVI.5 and XVII.2, archived PDF pp. 409–411 and 422–423; Etingof–Semenyakin Section 4.2, archived PDF pp. 24–25. A2 topological flatness is proved here by the compatible explicit bases.
proof_dependencies: UQ02; UQ05; UQ06; Lie Algebras and Finite-Dimensional Representations A05, PDF pp. 8–9

title: The first-order cobracket on sl3
source: Etingof–Semenyakin Section 4.2, archived PDF pp. 24–25; Kassel Section XVI.5, archived PDF pp. 409–411, for the skew classical limit. The root-vector formulas and co-Jacobi check are carried out here.

title: The coboundary tensor in the matrix model
source: Direct type-A2 matrix-unit calculation. Compare Etingof–Semenyakin Section 4.2, archived PDF pp. 24–25, for the classical Drinfeld–Jimbo bialgebra.

title: Adjoint cohomology of the three-dimensional Heisenberg algebra
source: Direct Chevalley–Eilenberg calculation here, using the convention in Lie Algebras and Finite-Dimensional Representations I01–I02, PDF p. 56.
proof_dependencies: Lie Algebras and Finite-Dimensional Representations I01–I02, PDF p. 56

title: Exactly which of these first-order classes extend
source: Explicit two-equation obstruction locus calculated here; general setup in Fialowski–Fuchs, Construction of Miniversal Deformations of Lie Algebras, §§1 and 3.
proof_dependencies: LD01; Lie Algebras and Finite-Dimensional Representations I02–I03, PDF pp. 56–57

title: Two extendable classes with an obstructed sum
source: Heisenberg example and generic split sl₂ identification by direct bracket computations in this chapter.

title: Lie bialgebras and coboundary cobrackets
source: Etingof–Semenyakin, A Brief Introduction to Quantum Groups, §4.2 (classical limit and Lie bialgebras); Etingof–Kazhdan, Quantization of Lie Bialgebras, I, §3 for the quantization setting.
proof_dependencies: Adjoint representation on an exterior square

title: The invariant Schouten-square criterion
source: Etingof–Semenyakin §4.2, classical Yang–Baxter discussion; direct exterior-power criterion proved here in the skew convention.
proof_dependencies: LD04; Lie Jacobi identity and exterior pairing

title: Two cobrackets on the split rank-one algebra
source: Explicit coboundary calculations in this chapter; for background compare Etingof–Semenyakin §4.2, and Topics in Rings, Modules, and Associative Algebras H11 for the rank-one quantum coproduct.

title: Linearized associativity, coassociativity, and compatibility
source: Markl, Intrinsic Brackets and the L-Infinity Deformation Theory of Bialgebras, §6 (bialgebra cohomology); direct first-order expansion with fixed unit and counit given here.

title: A nontrivial coproduct deformation of a polynomial Hopf algebra
source: Explicit skew-primitive formal Hopf deformation constructed here; for the classical-limit definition compare Etingof–Kazhdan §3.
proof_dependencies: LD07; formal exponential identity on commuting variables
